items.t: Hastings, Vancouver: 19 houses sold at a median of $1,665,000, with the middle half between $1,580,000 and $1,933,000. The median house took 11 days to sell and closed at 98.4% of list.

19 townhomes sold in Hastings, Vancouver at a median of $1,210,000 (middle half $1,028,250 to $1,282,500). A typical townhome in Hastings, Vancouver spent 9 days on the market and closed at 98.5% of the asking price.
In Hastings, Vancouver, condos sold at a median of $600,000 across 59 sales, and the middle half closed between $522,500 and $683,250. The median condo sat 14 days and sold for 97.7% of list.
Hastings, Vancouver: 9 duplexes sold at a median of $1,420,000, with the middle half between $1,225,000 and $1,440,000. The median duplex took 15 days to sell and closed at 97.9% of list.

blocks.text: Source: Paragon closed sales, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026; medians need 5 or more sales.
How Hastings compares with the rest of Vancouver East

items.t: Of 15 Vancouver East sub-areas with 5 or more house sales, Hastings ranks 10th highest at $1,665,000; the range is $1,510,000 (Collingwood) to $1,980,000 (Fraser). Renfrew VE ($1,620,000) sits just below and Renfrew Heights ($1,670,000) sits just above.

Townhomes in Hastings have the 4th highest median of 13 Vancouver East sub-areas, $1,210,000. Killarney is lowest at $796,000 and Main highest at $1,419,500. Fraser ($1,144,000) sits just below and Victoria VE ($1,225,000) sits just above.

Of 13 Vancouver East sub-areas with 5 or more condo sales, Hastings ranks 11th highest at $600,000; the range is $520,000 (Collingwood) to $898,950 (Main). Victoria VE ($533,000) sits just below and Strathcona ($620,000) sits just above.

Duplexes in Hastings have the 9th highest median of 15 Vancouver East sub-areas, $1,420,000. Strathcona is lowest at $1,112,500 and Main highest at $1,919,000. Renfrew VE ($1,350,000) sits just below and Killarney ($1,450,000) sits just above.

blocks.text: By build year, duplexes are the newest homes selling in Hastings, Vancouver (median 2010) and houses the oldest (median 1930), a gap of 80 years.
